//_cvc_status: run_5 CVC aborts at the Setting-models stage with: unexpected error: Resistance error: missing parameter: l in l/w*48. 48 ohm/sq is the sky130 non-silicided poly sheet resistance, so some device in the extracted CDL is being matched to a poly-resistor model without an l parameter. This is a PDK/tool model-resolution problem, NOT a design error: CVC never reached the checking stage, and Magic DRC, KLayout DRC and Netgen LVS all independently report zero. FAKEDIODE_CELL was investigated and RULED OUT - DIODE_INSERTION_STRATEGY is unset, so sky130_ef_sc_hd__fakediode_2 is never instantiated.
